g.title: j1583737724
g.text: Soldja1Shot1kil: say a man is peckish…

g.title: j1882717955
g.text: H16h V0l7463: ha! hungryhungryQuincy. y'know i had a board game like that growing up, and i bet I could -

g.title: j475882845
g.text: Offer is always open to join me.

g.title: j1941680969
g.text: It's a big food court, join in.

g.title: j1808332883
g.text: Soldja1Shot1kil: let me finish. say a man is peckish, but that sugar-coated corpo advertising vomit keeps playing in our ears in that food court. what would u say 2 me shooting hardware pumping the droning?

g.title: j1167557642
g.text: xX GLIMMER Xx: oo oo let me crush them. i’ll be careful not to damage Zeke! <RETRO_EMOJI_PUMPEDUP>

g.title: j4011436007
g.text: I told you we might need to put patients there, from outside these walls

g.title: j4112857412
g.text: Salem: Now now, dear Lettie. Hasn’t anyone noticed?

g.title: j1040951397
g.text: Salem: It’s not patients that have surrounded the mall’s walls out there, but inquisitive citizens who seem to feel… safer around here.

g.title: j361940424
g.text: H16h V0l7463: waitwaitwait. you mean we're... actually making a difference here?

g.title: j3693452208
g.text: Broadsword: We aren't a bad T

g.title: j3913137255
g.text: Soldja1Shot1kil: more mouths 2 feed... even if His Maj think's we're good n'cozy? not a good idea

g.title: j1928953961
g.text: Salem: I could dismiss them. It would take but a thought…

g.title: j3285885589
g.text: xX GLIMMER Xx: i can’t help but feel like...even if we try our best, why give the people a false comfort that we can save any of them? it’s not going to end up good for anyone.

g.title: j3882628807
g.text: Maybe that’s what this is about. Knowing WE can change things.

g.title: j3035916461
g.text: The more people here, right now, that feel hope, the better.

g.title: j794446874
g.text: H16h V0l7463: hmm, not to be a downer? but, I get the feeling we’d be inviting more people to the disappoint party.

g.title: j1949858363
g.text: Salem: But shouldn’t we tip the scales of fate? Even a tickle on the scale could be most interesting.

g.title: j3336977802
g.text: Belladonna ~{@: Sure then I’m the one responsible for runny noses and amputations?
My aunt always said "no big decisions on an empty stomach"
Let’s meet in the Food Court and discuss what to do

g.title: j3510509682
g.text: xX GLIMMER Xx: <RETRO_EMOJI_HAPPY2> ooooh! team lunch!

g.title: j567647126
g.text: Soldja1Shot1kil: in. and ur all welcome for kickin' this off

g.title: j3591998862
g.text: I’m glad we’re all doing something together.

g.title: j3932282306
g.text: Let’s protect them and each other.

g.title: j648556832
g.text: Thanks Quincy, thanks everyone. Guess it's bonding time.
